    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tt14_log) +
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tt9001_log) AS gesamt_logs;

UNION ALL

UNION ALL

panels.description: Telegramm-Durchsatz über die Zeit in 30-Sekunden-Fenstern, aufgeschlüsselt nach Typ (SDXP, TT14, TT9001). Quelle: alle drei Log-Tabellen per UNION

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', alle_telegramme."timestamp") 
    + INTERVAL '30 seconds' * FLOOR(EXTRACT(SECOND FROM alle_telegramme."timestamp") / 30) AS "time",
    typ AS steuerung,
    COUNT(*) AS anzahl
FROM (
    SELECT 'SDXP'  AS typ, "timestamp" FROM sdxp_log
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TT14',          "timestamp" FROM tt14_log
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TT9001',        "timestamp" FROM tt9001_log
) AS alle_telegramme
GROUP BY "time", typ
ORDER BY "time";

panels.description: SDXP-Telegrammaufkommen je Steuerung über die Zeit (30-Sekunden-Fenster); jedes Telegramm zählt für Sender und Empfänger, MFS ausgeschlossen

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('minute', "timestamp") + INTERVAL '30 seconds' * FLOOR(
    EXTRACT(
      SECOND
      FROM
        "timestamp"
    ) / 30
  ) AS "time",
  steuerung,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      "timestamp",
      sender AS steuerung
    FROM
      sdxp_log
    UNION
    ALL
    SELECT
      "timestamp",
      empfaenger AS steuerung
    FROM
      sdxp_log
  ) AS alle
WHERE
  steuerung != 'MFS'
GROUP BY
  "time",
  steuerung
ORDER BY
  "time";

panels.title: Anzahl SDXP Steuerungen

panels.description: TT14-Telegrammaufkommen je Steuerung über die Zeit (30-Sekunden-Fenster); jedes Telegramm zählt für Sender und Empfänger, MFS ausgeschlossen

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', "timestamp")
    + INTERVAL '30 seconds' * FLOOR(EXTRACT(SECOND FROM "timestamp") / 30) AS "time",
    steuerung,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM (
    SELECT "timestamp", sender     AS steuerung FROM tt14_log
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "timestamp", empfaenger AS steuerung FROM tt14_log
) AS alle
WHERE steuerung != 'MFS'
GROUP BY "time", steuerung
ORDER BY "time";
